name: Feature request
about: A new rule, flag or renderer capability
title: "[feature] "
labels: ""

---

**The contract change you want caught**

Describe the real-world contract change (endpoint, type, field, enum, arity,
idempotency...) that contractfault misses today.

**Proposed rule code + category**

Suggest the `code`, the category (breaking / additive / behavioral) and why.
Rule additions must include the test case and the `docs/CONTRACT.md` row.

**Proposed CLI behavior**

If this needs a flag: exact flag name, default value, and exit-code impact.
